venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below.

### SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.

### VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### SPONSORSHIP
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png)
A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.

### LUCKY DRAW

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more!

If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.name: CubingZA FMC Championship 2023

venue.name: Multiple Cities
venue.details: See the locations tab for more information about venue locations

items.information:
This Fewest Moves competition is part of CubingZA's South African National Championship for 2023, but is being hosted in three separate venues across the nation, namely Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban.

Please note that only the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be held officially - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or less in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event.

In between each attempt to break up the day will be breaks where we may compete in some unofficial relay events, like 3BLD relays, Guildford or Mini-guildford challenges, team-solving, or 2x2-7x7 relays. More information will be released about these closer to the competition.

**GUESTS**

Please note that guests and spectators are NOT welcome at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt.

items.name: Please Be Solved This Time Joburg 2023
items.information:
## This is not a normal competition

We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is entirely focused on blindfolded events,.

If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province.

**Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund.

## Venue

The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue.
There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information in the comments of their registration:

1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number.
2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with.
3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this.

Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address.

## Guests

Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. 

## About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023

venue.name: Mimosa Mall
venue.details: Open floor area set up in a shopping mall

items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2023 speedcubing competition! This competition will focus on a variety of shorter, popular events, several of which have never been held in Bloemfontein before. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make an EFT payment to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for the banking details and when registration opens.

### Masters and Challengers

This competition will recognise the performance of both established cubers and relatively new competitors - if you have never been to a competition before, or come from the Free State and your only other competition you have attended was Mimosa Mall Master Cubers 2022 (last year's competition), then you qualify as a Challenger. All Challengers will be able to qualify for their own prizes and podium places. Otherwise, if you have attended at least 2 competitions before, you are a Master Cuber and will be competing against some of the best in the country for the top prizes!

### All New Competitors

If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct.
Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp.

### Spectators

As this is a public venue in a shopping mall, any spectators can attend for free. Please be aware that there will be arranged seating specifically for parents and guardians of competitors, but this will be limited.

### Volunteering

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 

### Sponsorship

Massive thanks to Mimosa Mall for sponsoring this competition. As part of the sponsorship, they are providing the venue free of charge, as well as all of the competition sound/video equipment we will need and assisting with setup, advertising, and of course, providing a very generous amount of prize money for the winners!

### Lucky Draw

During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Saturday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: CubingZA National Championship 2023

venue.name: BMG World
venue.address: South Africa, 28 Droste Cres, Droste Park, Johannesburg, 2094

items.information:
CubingZA is excited to announce South Africa's 2023 National Championship. Compete against South Africa's fastest speedcubers and break some records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket on our [Quicket](https://www.quicket.co.za/events/216560-cubingza-national-championship-2023#/) page.


# COMPETING

This is an open championship - meaning anyone is free to compete. All WCA events except FMC* will be held, with winners in each event being declared the 2023 South African Champion for that event.


# SPECTATORS

Competitors are allowed to bring up to 2 guests as spectators. Spectators attend for free.


# VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at this video.

Parents and spectators are welcome to help out with volunteer tasks as well.


# SPONSORS

Massive thanks to the following sponsors, without whom this competition would not be happening.
BMG, who are generously providing their venue at BMG World for the competition, and making Nationals in Joburg a reality.
Speecubes.co.za and CubeCo, South Africa's local cube stores, who will be sponsoring prize money and store vouchers for the competition's winners.
InsightEdge (Pty) Ltd. has also generously offered to sponsor further prize money towards the winners and podium finishers.

*\*A separate FMC Championship will be held at a later date. This championship will take place simultaneously in multiple locations (CPT, JHB and DBN) to minimise travel requirements.*

### General Information

This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that due to the nature of the festival the venue will be extremely noisy, and this is outside of our control. The competition will be taking place in a large tent, and it is June, so dress warmly.

### Competitor Tickets

Please register for the competition and select your events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2022/register), and then pay for your registration at:
https://www.quicket.co.za/events/175059-speed-cubing-arnold-classic-africa/#/
Tickets for competitors cost R200, which includes access to the rest of the expo and sport festival.


### Guests

Spectators are welcome, but will need to pay for entrance to the expo. Tickets can be bought online through [WebTickets](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420) or paid for at the door. Various pricing options are available depending on whether you wish to attend for the whole weekend or just one day.
**[Tickets for guests](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420)**

### Volunteering

We will require volunteers to support with running and judging on the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact the organisers. Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing.

venue.address: Main Rd, Sea Point, Cape Town, 8005

items.information:
Please register for the competition via the World Cube Association website before attending the competition in order to speed up the registration process on the day. Also note that the competitor limit is set at **100 competitors**. Please register early in order to secure your place in the competition. We are allowing on-the-day registrations but please be aware that if you arrive on the day without registering and/or paying for your entry ticket, we cannot guarantee that you will be able to compete if the competitor limit has been reached.

Entry fee for the competition with be R200.00. Please pay online at Speedcubes using the following URL: https://www.speedcubes.co.za/19-competitions. Please note that we will not confirm your registration until you have paid for your entry ticket! Please email Proof of Payment to maverickpearson@gmail.com, and include in the email the FULL NAME of the competitor that the entry ticket was purchased for.

Also note that Covid protocols will be in place. Each competitor and vistors will be required to wear face masks and to sanitise regularly.

We will be releasing a Judging, Running and Scrambling video and potentially hosting an in-person tutorial before the competition date in order to familiarise both competitors and spectators who wish to volunteer with running the competition. We will be requiring everyone who wishes to judge or scramble to watch the video and attend the tutorial, especially if you are less than 12 years old or are a new competitor. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly.

Due to the school hall's capacity, we are limiting each competitor to a maximum of 4 visitors/spectators, who can attend for free.

The organiser and sponsor for the event is Speedcubes.co.za and there will be a limited number of cubes for sale on the day.

venue.address: 152 President Boshoff Rd, Rynfield AH, Benoni, 1501

items.information:
## Registration

Please register for the competition via the World Cube Association website before attending the competition in order to speed up the registration process on the day. Also note that the competitor limit is set at **100 competitors**. Please register and pay early in order to secure your place in the competition. We are allowing on-the-day registrations but please be aware that if you arrive on the day without registering and/or paying for your entry ticket, we cannot guarantee that you will be able to compete if the competitor limit has been reached.

Tickets to compete start at **R 200.00**. Please pay online at https://fayview.com/product/wca-gauteng-autumn-participant/. Please note that we will not confirm your registration until you have paid for your entry ticket! 

Three ticket types are available:

- **R 200** allows you to compete in the competition.
- **R 250** allows you to compete, and also allows you access to a VIP lounge with non-alcoholic drinks and finger foods throughout the day, as well as couches, seating and a TV screen displaying results.
- **R 450** includes both of the above, and also includes a competition T-Shirt.


## Guests

Tickets for spectators are available here: https://fayview.com/product/wca-gauteng-autumn-spectator/

- **R 25** ticket will allow you access to the main competition area as a spectator.
- **R 100** will also allow you access to the VIP lounge.
- **R 300** includes both of the above, and also includes a competition T-Shirt.


## Other Information

Also note that Covid protocols will be in place. Each competitor and vistors will be required to wear face masks and to sanitise regularly.

The competition is sponsored by Speedcubes.co.za, and some puzzles will be available for sale at the competition.
